process.label: 03 / how it works
process.title: From first message to live page

s1.title: A chat on WhatsApp
s1.description: Tell me what you do, who the page is for and what you need it to do. From there I send you a price and a timeline.

s2.title: Your brand material
s2.description: Logo, color palette, brand guidelines, photos, copy: send whatever you have. Anything missing, we sort out together.

s3.title: Build and revisions
s3.description: I build the page and send you a preview link. Three rounds of revisions are included before it goes live.

s4.title: Launch
s4.description: The page goes live on a .vercel.app address or on your own domain. Then all you do is share the link.

brandFirst.title: Your brand leads
brandFirst.body: If you already have a visual identity, the page is built entirely on it. The more material you send, the more the page looks like you, and the less it looks like a template.

ai.title: Where AI fits in
ai.body: I use AI to speed up parts of the work, like first drafts and repetitive code. The design decisions, the code review and the final result are mine. That's how the timeline stays short without cutting corners on the finish.

pricing.label: 04 / pricing
pricing.title: You see the price before we talk

items.i1: One-page landing page, designed to lead to WhatsApp

notes.complexity: Prices are a starting point and change with the complexity of the page.
notes.domain: You buy the domain (e.g. yourbrand.com) and pay the yearly fee directly to the registrar. I handle the setup.
notes.extras: Extra sections, a second language and integrations: quoted on request.

about.title: Who builds your page
about.body: I'm Douglas Tertuliano, a full-stack developer with 8 years of experience. I work at a large company and, on the side, build landing pages for freelancers and small businesses. You talk to me directly, from the first message until the page is live.
about.aiLine: AI helps me move faster. The judgment and the code are mine.

q1.question: How long does it take?
q1.answer: 5 to 10 business days, counted from when I receive your material. The exact timeline depends on complexity, and I'll give it to you before we start.

q2.question: What do I need to send?
q2.answer: Whatever you have: logo, color palette, brand guidelines, photos and copy. The more material, the more the page looks like you. If something is missing, we work it out in our chat.

q3.question: Can I ask for changes?
q3.answer: Yes. Three rounds of revisions are included before launch. Anything beyond that, or after the page is live, is quoted separately.

q4.question: Do I need a domain?
q4.answer: No. With Essential, the page lives on a .vercel.app address. If you want your own address, like yourbrand.com, you buy the domain and I set it up in the Professional package. The domain is a yearly fee paid directly to the registrar.

q5.question: How does payment work?
q5.answer: 50% to start and 50% on delivery, by Pix or credit card.

q6.question: Do you work with my kind of business?
q6.answer: I work with any business that needs a landing page. I mostly work with freelancers and small businesses: nutritionists, therapists, consultants, agencies and people selling a course or ebook.
